TRAIN LAB
ⓘExample menus only — not personalized nutrition advice.⌄

FUEL LAB supports meal planning and nutrition education. Current example menus, portions and nutrient estimates are preliminary, not individually source-verified or validated, and are not a personalized nutrition prescription. The app does not provide allergy clearance or clinical nutrition planning. An imported training schedule does not establish your energy needs or medical suitability.

Before following a plan or changing foods, consult a qualified nutrition professional and, when appropriate, a physician. Check food labels, ingredients and allergens, especially if you have allergies, medical conditions, take medications, or have other special dietary needs. Never change medical treatment based on this app.

About the food data

Not individually verified USDA records. Do not use for clinical planning. No meal recommendations or medical advice.

Preliminary values per 100 g. Some additional nutrient records have source matches; legacy macronutrients remain preliminary. Formula: nutrient × grams ÷ 100. Preparation and brand change results.

Production records will require USDA FDC ID, data type, publication/retrieval date, edible portion, nutrient units and documented gram weights. No public API key is embedded.

USDA FoodData Central — source reference ↗

Future production data must include a named source, food identifier, edible portion, units, nutrient values, version/date, and allergen review where relevant. No user data is saved here.
